findings.title: Coefficient record omits the source-orientation multiplier
findings.mechanism: construct multiplies by source sign to the observable power; the object coefficient accessor delegates a local coefficient without that multiplier in its meaning.
findings.delta: No Power override or translation is used. This concerns chart-to-observable coefficient reconstruction, not the coefficient recurrence.

findings.title: Model Limit is a normalization offset for negative leading powers
findings.mechanism: rowsToModel starts y0 at zero and removes a constant only if it is the first row; public PowerLogModel exposes this value as Limit.
findings.derived_result: Limit field 0, leading power -1, leading coefficient 1; actual right-hand target limit +Infinity
findings.delta: A concrete public model field, not a residual label or general schema recommendation.

findings.title: Perturbative core can contain the source variable being eliminated
findings.mechanism: Both implementations test x!=y and FreeQ[h,y] but not source occurrences in phi.
findings.delta: Valid call arity with an invalid core, not a wrong formula on valid core data or a coefficient accessor kind check.
findings.repair_scope: The candidate FreeQ guard is structural; bound same-named occurrences need a broader scope-aware policy if such cores are supported.

findings.title: Global strict monotonicity with isolated stationary points
findings.mechanism: The inspected global helper requires a strictly signed derivative for the polynomial case.
findings.derived_result: Strictly increasing globally despite stationary points -1 and 1
findings.delta: Whole-line injectivity, not a deleted-neighborhood radius. A different dispatcher path can still succeed.
